images.screen: A · 듣고 걷기 — listening for cracks before each step
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down view of a frozen lake at dusk, a small bundled figure in a navy parka with a fur hood and red scarf standing mid-ice, a trail of footprints behind with little rings marking where they stopped to listen. The ice is rendered crisply: pale cyan-white surface with frost grain, fine white hairline cracks with blue-grey shadows, trapped air bubbles, wind-blown snow streaks, and dark blue blotches of deep water showing through thin patches. Around the player, a translucent radial sound-listening dial of eight wedges, tinted calm blue, amber and one red wedge toward the northeast, each with a small rounded label like "고요", "삐걱", "쩍"; soft expanding sound rings pulse outward. A snowy shoreline with dark green pines and a red flag waits on the right edge. Frosted-glass HUD cards: big timer "01:42", distance "146 m", and a bottom audio strip with a live crack waveform and the reading "북동 쩍". Cold, clean, tense, readable.

images.screen: B · 멈춰! — the ice splits underfoot
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same top-down frozen lake, now a moment of failure about to happen: directly under the parka-clad figure the ice is shattering in a star of bright white radial fractures with dark shadow lines, concentric dashed fracture rings, flying ice shards, and a jagged hole opening into near-black blue water beside them. A shrinking red reaction ring closes around the player. The whole frame has a red pulsing vignette and slight camera shake blur. Above the player, huge bold white Korean text "멈춰!" with a thick red outline and a red pill caption beneath it. Frosted-glass HUD: timer turned red "00:18", distance to shore "12 m" with the snowy pine shoreline and red flag very close on the right, and the bottom audio strip spiking red and orange with the label "콰직— 콰직". High contrast icy whites, deep navy water, alarm red. Consistency: the player character is the exact same small figure as the listening screen — navy parka with fur hood and red scarf — seen from the same high top-down camera height and at the same small on-screen scale, same stylized rendering.
